metadata.title: Zero Masala Desi Chicken cooked in Jungle | भीमा भाई की ज़ीरो मसाला देसी चिकन रेसिपी
metadata.description: Gond is the largest tribal group of the Bastar region in Chhattisgarh. Our team travelled to many village of Bastar in the first week of November. During this visit we got a chance to meet the people of Gudiya Padar village in dense forest of Bastar. Bhima Bhai of this village cooked country chicken for our dinner.
